$comment: Project-scope MCP servers. `tazuna mcp add <name>` merges `server` into the project's .mcp.json and enables it in .claude/settings.json. Credentials only as ${ENV_VAR} placeholders.

azure-devops.purpose: On-premises Azure DevOps Server: pull requests, work items, wiki, search (PAT, API 7.0); asks for the project URL and a PAT, this project only
azure-devops.$scope: Registered in Claude Code local scope by scripts/configure-ado.ps1, never merged into .mcp.json: it adds AZURE_DEVOPS_ORG_URL, AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT and AZURE_DEVOPS_DEFAULT_PROJECT per project.

serena.purpose: Symbol navigation through a language server: callers, implementations, declarations

drawio.purpose: Open and edit diagrams in the draw.io editor

plantuml.purpose: Render PlantUML diagrams; the diagram source goes to PLANTUML_SERVER_URL (public plantuml.com unless you set it)

mermaid.purpose: Render Mermaid diagrams and charts locally to SVG or PNG
